newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy confidence vote expected this afternoon.
newsitem.headline: Italy confidence vote expected this afternoon.

text.p: A confidence vote in the Senate (upper house) which the Italian government called on part of its 1997 budget was due to be held on Wednesday afternoon.
The government called the vote on Wednesday morning to sweep away hundreds of blocking amendments.
Parliamentary sources said the entire cost-cutting budget could be approved by Wednesday night or Thursday morning. It then returns to the Chamber of Deputies (lower house) for a final reading.

The latest confidence vote concerns the part of the budget which sets spending limits and the bulk of outstanding amendments refer to this section. Most of the rest of the budget has already been approved in full by the Senate.

Civil Service Minister Franco Bassanini told the Senate the centre-left coalition was forced to resort to the measure so that the package could be approved on schedule by both houses of parliament by the legal deadline of December 31. --Rome newsroom 396-6782501
